title: Bounded register transfer run
statement: Let $A$ be a register program, fix an oracle and input, and suppose registers $r$ and $t$ are distinct. Suppose the instructions at states $l,l_1,l_2,l_3$ are, respectively, a zero test on $r$ branching to $l_x$ or $l_1$, a decrement of $r$ leading to $l_2$, an increment of $t$ leading to $l_3$, and an increment of $t$ leading back to $l$. For every $k$ and register valuation $v$ with $v(r)=k$, all registers bounded above by $B$, and $v(t)+2v(r)\le B$, there is a finite run from state $l$ with valuation $v$ to state $l_x$ with $r$ reset to zero and $t$ increased by $2v(r)$, leaving the other registers unchanged; every configuration before the endpoint satisfies the guard that its precondition holds and all registers are at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: Every initial register value is at most $B$
